title: Pink Coastal Ocean PNG Clipart Bundle
author: Marrie Pauza
description:
Pink Coastal Ocean Clipart Bundle | Whimsical Marine Life PNG Set | Cute Pastel Nautical Watercolor Animals | Feminine Beach Aesthetic Clip Art | Tropical Folk Art Sea Creatures
WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE
40 individual clipart illustrations
PNG format
High resolution (3600 x 3600 px)
Transparent background
Hand-painted watercolor texture
Folk-art inspired decorative details
Instant digital download
Commercial use included
This Pink Coastal Ocean Clipart Bundle features a dreamy collection of whimsical marine life illustrations designed in a feminine pastel folk-art watercolor style. The artwork combines decorative ocean animals with floral botanical detailing, coastal fantasy aesthetics, and soft beach-inspired color palettes perfect for trendy summer-themed creative projects.
The collection includes beautifully stylized seahorses, dolphins, sea turtles, starfish, shrimp, lobsters, coral reefs, tropical fish, seashells, jellyfish, whales, and many more decorative underwater creatures. Each illustration is filled with ornate floral patterns, leafy swirls, watercolor textures, and flowing whimsical details that create a soft artistic ocean fantasy atmosphere.
The palette focuses on trendy feminine tones including pink, dusty rose, coral red, teal green, seafoam, pastel turquoise, and soft coastal hues, making the entire collection highly cohesive for aesthetic branding and modern digital design.
Every illustration is isolated on a transparent background, making the bundle ideal for both digital and print applications.
This collection is especially suited for creators and customers who love:
pink coastal aesthetics
beach girl vibes
kawaii ocean art
feminine summer themes
trendy pastel illustrations
tropical scrapbook styles
cute nautical designs
whimsical marine life
Perfect for Etsy sellers, junk journal creators, scrapbook artists, stationery brands, and print-on-demand businesses looking for highly searchable feminine summer artwork with strong aesthetic appeal.
PERFECT FOR
junk journals
scrapbook kits
planner stickers
printable stickers
digital collage
